faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Badrinath Forest Division recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Badrinath Forest Division Subject Matter Expert post is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Subject Matter Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Science from a recognized university. Additionally, a minimum of 15 years of experience in Silviculture & Forest Management is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Subject Matter Expert position is 70 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Subject Matter Expert role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with the required documents to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Subject Matter Expert position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this post will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential skills required for the Subject Matter Expert role?
faq.answer: Besides the educational qualification and experience, candidates should have knowledge of Uttarakhand geography, proficiency in MS Office, MS Excel, Internet, and data analysis skills.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Badrinath Forest Division, which is www.forest.uk.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Subject Matter Expert (Silviculture & Forest Management) is on a contractual basis.
